name: psychology
description: Psychology Plugin -- an AI-powered self-understanding and self-assessment plugin wrapping Psychology MCP, Seges.ai's free psychometric scoring server built under Project Noesis. A from-scratch, non-Connact-branded self-understanding and self-assessment plugin for general adults maintaining their cognitive/mental abilities in the AI era (welcoming to neurodivergent people among everyone else, not ND-exclusive). Standalone: not part of the Salecraft enterprise suite, no shared identity/auth with those plugins. Connects to a hosted remote MCP server at https://noesis.seges.ai/mcp, exposing 37 tools: 26 from the noesis_mcp scoring package (16 public scoring instruments plus 10 utility tools) and, added 2026-08-06, 11 native account/consent/journal tools -- covering consent management (granted only on the website, never via a tool call), saving scored results, a distilled profile snapshot, and free-text journal entries -- written directly into the connector for a signed-in user. The account is free and takes about a minute to create at https://noesis.seges.ai/connect (Google or phone sign-in), and since 2026-08-01 every tool call carries a personal access token, supplied through the NOESIS_PAT environment variable. The 16 scoring instruments: a Big Five quick screen and a Schwartz-style values questionnaire (neither is the published TIPI or the 2012 PVQ-RR, despite the similar names), CAT-Q, ASRS Part A, ECR-R, SWLS, IPIP-VIA-R, IPIP-NEO-120, a financial-literacy-and-calibration self-assessment, a wellness self-tracking battery, a Cross-Cultural Adaptability scale, a Research & Analysis Ability self-report, a Reasoning Style inventory (REI-40), a Self-Regulated Learning process scale, a Charisma/Self-Presentation self-assessment, and a Reasoning Ability performance test (graded multi-step arithmetic + structured logic, not a self-report scale) -- plus domain-filtered interpretation, plain-language norm descriptions, battery aggregation, an item-bank/instrument catalog, an instrument-naming consistency checker, two local non-clinical referral-suggestion tools (added 2026-08-01), and a real Google Places-backed "find a real counselor" referral feature for anyone who wants actual licensed outside help (Noesis itself does not provide counseling or therapy; this feature is available to every signed-in user, limited to 20 searches/week and 40 searches/month per user since it calls a real, paid external API).

plugins.name: psychology
plugins.description: A psychology plugin: AI-powered self-understanding and self-assessment for general adults in the AI era -- welcoming to neurodivergent people among everyone else, not ND-exclusive, and not a clinical service. 37 real MCP tools reachable through this plugin's connector: 26 from the noesis_mcp scoring package -- 16 scoring instruments (score_big_five, score_pvq_rr, score_cat_q, score_asrs_part_a, score_ecr_r, score_swls, score_ipip_via_r, score_ipip_neo120, score_financial_calibration, score_wellness_tracking, score_cross_cultural_adaptability, score_research_analysis, score_reasoning_style, score_self_regulated_learning, score_charisma, score_reasoning_ability), plus domain_filtered_report, battery_aggregate, battery_aggregate_json, check_instrument_consistency, describe_norm, get_item_bank, list_instruments, find_counselors (a "find a real counselor" referral to actual licensed outside counselors -- Noesis itself never provides counseling or therapy; available to every signed-in user, limited to 20 searches/week and 40 searches/month per user since it calls a real, paid external API), get_verify_product_recommendations, and check_cognitive_wellness_referral -- over a hosted remote server at https://noesis.seges.ai/mcp. Added 2026-08-06: 11 more native tools live on the connector itself (not the noesis_mcp package) for consent management (get_consent_status -- read-only; consent is granted only on the website at https://noesis.seges.ai, never via a tool call, per an explicit 2026-08-06 founder/legal decision that consent-granting must be traceable to a real website session), saving and listing scored results (save_assessment_result, list_my_assessments), a distilled profile snapshot (save_my_profile, get_my_profile), and a free-text journal (journal_write_entry, journal_search, journal_get_recent, journal_view_memory, journal_grant_access, journal_revoke_access) -- each gated on the user's own explicit, informed consent, never assumed. Setup is one free account at https://noesis.seges.ai/connect plus a personal access token set as the NOESIS_PAT environment variable; nothing is installed or run locally. 8 skills (assessment-guide, interpretation, coaching, ema-review, crisis-support, l00-context-delegate, local-persistence, memory-distillation) provide strength-framed, non-clinical guidance; crisis handling is reasoning-only (no fabricated safety-classification tool) and routes to real outside help rather than Noesis treating the crisis itself; l00-context-delegate is a structured protocol for inferring answers from existing context with a mandatory construct-validity guardrail; local-persistence is a client-side save/resume convention (Write/Read/Edit to a user-controlled file) for users without a saved-results account, complementary to (not replaced by) the native save_assessment_result tool above.
